priority_items.title: PIF/COP31 — PRF still ~US$200m vs US$500m; Heine rejects 1.5°C overshoot; pledging session did not close the gap
priority_items.summary: Forumsec 10 Nov release (HTTP LM 14 Nov 02:20 GMT) plus PC/PINA 14 Nov restamp of the Albanese–Whipps–Bowen Antalya presser: PRF spoken stock US$200 million (US$100 million Pacific+ANZ) against a US$500 million 2026 capitalisation target. Climate Home 12 Nov leftover: pledging session produced no new government money; Minderoo US$5 million. RNZ 14 Nov 00:35 UTC: Heine, Whipps and Simina reject a 1.5°C overshoot as an option. Not a security pact. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: ASM/WSM/COK — JTWC INVEST 95P MEDIUM; Nadi TD02F LOW TO MODERATE; no land warning
priority_items.summary: JTWC ABPW 140600Z: Invest 95P at 9.0S 157.8W, ~823 NM ENE of Pago Pago, 28–33 kt / 1005 mb, MEDIUM potential within 24 hours. FMS TDS 132230 UTC: TD02F 1007 hPa near 09.0S 159.0W, LOW TO MODERATE, no other disturbance, no SWB. Marianas CAP empty. Not named. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: PNG/TWN — this-window shell-investigation commentary; gap leftover Taiwan trade-office closure is not a recognition switch
priority_items.summary: PC/RFA 14 Nov: RPNGC confirmed a 130 mm round seized 29 Oct; four Chinese nationals detained; both US and PRC embassy public claims contested by a PNG commentator as narrative warfare. Gap leftover Taiwan MOFA 6 Nov: Taipei Economic Office in Port Moresby closed, aid ended, PNG spot LNG halted. PNG already recognizes the PRC. Not a recognition flip. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: VUT — PAC finds 1,390 diplomatic passports unaccounted for; NCM leftover withdrawn
priority_items.summary: PC 14 Nov syndicating OCCRP/PAC: 1,390 diplomatic passports missing 2019–2024 (1,301 in 2024). Alleged irregular special-envoy appointments involving Napat and Ati. Leftover 11 Nov: opposition withdrew no-confidence motion against Napat. Parliamentary. Not extra-constitutional. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: NZL — 7 Nov election still uncertified; Pacific-vote copy this window; official 27 Nov
priority_items.summary: Electoral Commission preliminary: Labour 29.36% / National 29.21%; National–ACT–NZ First 67 of 131 on prelims; Opportunity 7 seats. Official results 27 Nov. RNZ Pacific 13–14 Nov: Pacific-heavy electorates and Pacific MPs. Uncertified. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: AUS/USA/GBR — USS Colorado at HMAS Stirling; Brat first Perth visit; SRF-West still 2027
priority_items.summary: US Embassy 13 Nov: Ambassador Brat toured USS Colorado at Stirling with Marles and UK chargé. Colorado is in scheduled maintenance and is designated first SRF-West boat for late 2027. Leftover Marles 12 Nov workforce/housing spend. Maintenance visit ≠ rotation in force. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: KIR/MHL/FSM — Kiribati fisheries observer missing; MIMRA 13 Nov vessel in Majuro
priority_items.summary: Observer missing from Marshall Islands-flagged KOO’S 103 in the FSM EEZ about 2130 5 Nov; 72-hour search unsuccessful. MIMRA 13 Nov: vessel in Majuro, boarded, investigation open, no indication of foul play so far. Humanitarian / observer-safety. Not FLASH.
